fact: As of early 2022 Mauritius had implemented DHIS2 as its national HMIS for aggregate and Tracker data on EPI, AEFI, COVID-19 vaccination, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS and TB, with AEFI data extracted from DHIS2 into VigiFlow.
title: Integrating DHIS2 data with VigiFlow for reporting AEFI cases in Mauritius
